decisions.task: 3. Resolve newer psyllium extraction, units and shared-control questions before use
decisions.outcome: Numerical estimate excluded; original-data reanalysis remains unresolved
observations: Authors explicitly identify repeated rows as distinct trial arms; repeated author names alone are not evidence of accidental duplication.
The methods report general change-score and variance formulas but the retrieved text does not establish a shared-control splitting or covariance strategy for each multi-arm/crossover trial.
Table 1 expresses dose in g/day and includes awkward or incomplete rows; methods and figure captions also refer to mg/day. Do not silently reconcile these units.
The results report an LDL weighted mean difference of -8.55 without an explicit concentration unit in the displayed result. Source-trial unit harmonization has not been independently verified.
LDL heterogeneity is 88.46%; Egger p=0.04 while Begg p=0.36. This is an inconsistent small-study-effect signal, not proof of misconduct.
All listed risk-of-bias comparisons are rated high by the review authors. Underlying trial risks were not independently reassessed.
decisions.rule: Do not publish or convert the pooled estimate. No claim that an error was proven or corrected. Future numerical use requires underlying data, unit reconciliation and appropriate multi-arm/crossover reanalysis.

conditions: Use an inulin-specific scope, not a general-fiber mortality conclusion.
Show General Mills support and the authors’ no-conflicts declaration side by side.
Keep standing and sponsor-role checks visibly incomplete.
Retain the 28 g Daily Value only as label-reference context.
Omit held-source claims; do not merely relabel them as cleared.
Both education entry points require integration testing before claiming completion.
